deadlock_critical.recommendation: Transaction blocked for an extended period at ERROR level. Possible deadlock or system issue.

deadlock_warning.recommendation: Transaction blocked 50s+. Monitor for resolution. Expected during large sync operations.

ditto_query_size_exceeded.pattern: Query too big\. It exceeded the server's size limit of [\d.]+ [A-Z]+
ditto_query_size_exceeded.recommendation: Query exceeded the server's size limit. Replication has been disabled. Add more selective filters, reduce dataset size, or split the query.

certificate_expired.recommendation: Peers in the mesh have expired certificates. Check device clocks.

certificate_not_valid_yet.recommendation: Peers in the mesh have certificates generated in the future. Check device clocks.

ditto_authentication_failure.pattern: Request did not contain valid credentials
ditto_authentication_failure.recommendation: Device is not authenticating correctly. Verify the token and Auth URL.

connection_incomplete.recommendation: Connection terminated mid-transmission. Check network stability and retry logic.

memory_oom.recommendation: Memory pressure detected — check host limits and process memory usage.

crash_signal.recommendation: Process crashed with a fatal signal. Capture a crash report and check for upstream bug reports.

replication_metadata_corrupt_recovery.pattern: session metadata database was corrupt on open; deleting and reinitializing this peer's metadata, then retrying
replication_metadata_corrupt_recovery.recommendation: Per-peer replication metadata was corrupt on open and is being deleted and re-initialized automatically; application documents are unaffected (expected with relaxed_sync_metadata_durability after unclean shutdowns). Watch the ditto.replication.metadata_corrupt_recoveries metric — a sustained high rate for the same remote peer suggests frequent unclean shutdowns or storage problems on that device.

replication_consecutive_resets.pattern: resetting replication state with remote peer; sync performance may be temporarily degraded
replication_consecutive_resets.recommendation: Replication state with a remote peer has been reset repeatedly without a successful sync in between (WARN = 2nd+ consecutive reset); sync performance is temporarily degraded. Watch the ditto.replication.session_resets metric and check mesh stability with that peer (intermittent connectivity, clock skew, or divergent state).

replication_reset_local_trigger.pattern: replication reset was triggered by local peer
replication_reset_local_trigger.recommendation: A non-benign local error forced a replication reset (benign causes log at INFO instead). Inspect the line's error field for the cause and watch the ditto.replication.session_resets metric; repeated resets warrant checking local storage and sync configuration.

post_eviction_cleanup_frequent.pattern: post-eviction session cleanup is running too frequently, which may cause excessive local overhead
post_eviction_cleanup_frequent.recommendation: Eviction-triggered session cleanup ran 2+ times within 3x replication_gc_debounce_ms (this is logged at INFO by design). If the evictions all come from one collection, batch them into fewer eviction calls or increase the replication_gc_debounce_ms system parameter.
